replay: Press the button to replay the song I like.
The match was a draw, so we replay it on Friday.
I lost the level, so I will replay it.

rewrite: I made spelling mistakes, so I will rewrite the page.
Can you rewrite this poem with some different rhymes?
Let's rewrite the ending of the story to make it funnier!
rebuild: The wind knocked down our den, so we will rebuild it.
Can we rebuild the tower of bricks, taller this time?
The little bird will rebuild its nest in the spring.
subway: Dad pushed the pram through the subway under the main road.
Our shortcut to the park is the subway beneath the road!
Is there a subway under the big roundabout?
superstar: The pop superstar sang at the concert and the crowd clapped.
I want to be a famous superstar and sing on stage!
The superstar signed my poster after the concert.
subtract: If you subtract two from ten, you have eight left.
Can you subtract seven from twelve?
To find how many are left, you subtract!
superhero: The superhero in my comic can lift a bus.
I wore a red cape and a mask like a superhero.
Is that a superhero flying past the window?
submarine: The submarine sailed silently under the sea.
Fish swam past the window of the submarine.
I drew a submarine with a round window under the waves.
supermarket: We bought milk, bread and eggs at the supermarket.
Which aisle in the supermarket has the biscuits?
I helped carry the shopping bags out of the supermarket!
